audit.whatIsWrong: Rows 5 and 6 said Poppy while their own text says otherwise — whys[5] ends in 'a stalemate' and whys[6] plus spikes[3] both say Tahm reclaims the game. Row 4 said Skill while the packet gives it to Poppy and whys[4] describes her staying in control.

audit.whatIsWrong: Slot errors throughout. Devour is R, not W — the page says 'his W devour' three times. Abyssal Dive (W) is a 21s dive that knocks up, not 'his escape + shield'; the shield is Thick Skin (E) on a 3s cooldown. Tongue Lash was described as a plain stun when it only stuns at three stacks of An Acquired Taste. And 'W any dash he tries' has nothing to eat: no ability in his kit carries a dash flag.
audit.why: The three-stack condition is the whole early game — you can count the stacks and know exactly when the stun exists. Thick Skin being a 3s shield rather than a heal is why poking once and walking away accomplishes nothing.
audit.corrected: Devour named as R, Abyssal Dive as the knockup dive with its 21s cooldown, Thick Skin as the stored-damage shield, and Tongue Lash's three-stack stun condition written in.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing warned that Tongue Lash cancels Keeper's Verdict.
audit.why: Poppy's R is a channel; a three-stack Tongue Lash is hard CC at 900 range, so an unbaited ult costs the full 140s. The mirror audit tahmkench__poppy already tells the Tahm player to hold the stun for exactly this.
audit.corrected: Written into wants.you[2], the cooldown lines and the early/mid paragraphs.

audit.why: 21/20/19/18/17s on the dive; Tongue Lash at 7s rank 1 is the one that actually decides trades.

edits.before: Levels 2-3 are your real window: once you have Q and E, look to E him into a wall for the stun and chain your max-HP Q smash. His grey-health passive and W devour mean you have to commit those trades before he regenerates the chip and heals it off, so don't poke with one ability and walk away. Respect his Q tongue stun — if you E in carelessly and whiff the wall, he can tongue-stun you and turn the trade. Use the percent-HP on your Q to keep his big bar honest even when you're behind on gold.
edits.after: Levels 2-3 are your real window: once you have Q and E, E him into a wall for the stun and chain the max-HP Q smash. Thick Skin turns the chip you deal into a shield on a 3s cooldown, so commit the trade instead of poking once and walking away. Respect Tongue Lash: it only stuns once An Acquired Taste is at three stacks, so count them — and never start a Keeper's Verdict channel while that stun is available, because it cancels the ult and costs you the whole cooldown.

edits.before: Levels 4-6 flatten out: your flat base damage doesn't scale with ability points the way his sustain does, so you chunk him with Q and E wall-stuns but rarely convert a kill because grey health and W eat the burst. At 6 your R is a peel/disengage and displacement tool, not a kill spike — use it to keep him from devouring an ally or to pin him, not to chase. His real threat at 6 is his own R: if he roams, your slow waveclear means you can't punish the cross-map play, so ping it and try to keep him stuck in lane.
edits.after: Levels 4-6 flatten out: your flat base damage doesn't scale with points the way his sustain does, so you chunk him with Q and E wall-stuns but rarely convert a kill, because Thick Skin's shield eats the burst. At 6 your R is peel and displacement, not a kill spike — use it to stop a Devour on an ally or to pin him, never to chase, and never channel it with three stacks on you. His own R is the bigger threat: if he roams, your slow waveclear can't punish it, so ping it and keep him in lane.
